en.headline: Man dies after suspected drowning off Sai Kung's Wong Shek Pier
en.dek: A 26-year-old was pulled unconscious from the water about 20 metres off the pier on Saturday night and later certified dead at Tseung Kwan O Hospital.
body: A 26-year-old man died after a suspected drowning off Wong Shek Pier in Sai Kung on Saturday night, police said.

Passers-by reported a person in the water off Pak Tam Road at about 10pm. Rescue crews found the man about 20 metres offshore. Firefighters brought him ashore unconscious and an ambulance took him to Tseung Kwan O Hospital, where he was later certified dead.
Police said the man was non-Chinese. Officers are investigating the circumstances. The cause of death awaits a post-mortem examination.

zh.headline: 西貢黃石碼頭對開疑遇溺 26歲男子送院後不治
zh.dek: 途人周六晚報稱北潭路黃石碼頭對開約20米海面有人遇溺，男子昏迷送往將軍澳醫院後證實死亡。
body: 西貢黃石碼頭對開周六晚懷疑有人遇溺，一名26歲男子其後證實不治，警方正調查事件。
警方昨晚約10時接獲途人報案，指北潭路黃石碼頭對開海面懷疑有人遇溺。救援人員在離岸約20米發現事主，消防將他救起時已陷昏迷，由救護車送往將軍澳醫院，其後證實死亡。
警方表示事主為非華裔男子，正調查事故經過，死因有待驗屍後確定。
